# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free project environment. Be constructive, assume good intent, focus criticism on technical work, and do not publish private information about others.

Project maintainers may remove content or restrict participation when behavior is abusive, threatening, discriminatory, intentionally disruptive, or otherwise harmful to the community.

Report conduct concerns privately through the repository owner rather than opening a public issue containing sensitive details.
